title: wm-lucid — the flight recorder for the agorabus bus
root_motivation: Every wm.* event already flows over the agorabus bus but nothing records it; wm-lucid subscribes to the whole wm. prefix and persists every event to a rotating, turn-keyed structured log that survives daemon and reboot death. It is the foundational crate the rest of the lucid fleet reads from.

schema_contract.record: src/record.rs::Record {v, ts_received, topic, turn_id?, from, raw_payload}
schema_contract.log_format: NDJSON, one record per line, in segment-<n>.ndjson files
schema_contract.index: index.ndjson sidecar: {key, segment, line}; key = turn_id or untagged-<ts>

acceptance_criteria.text: Starts, registers as an agorabus peer with a wm-lucid intent tag, and subscribes to the full wm. prefix.
A burst of N published wm.* events results in N persisted records, each carrying {ts_received, topic, turn_id?, from, raw_payload}.
Records are keyed/indexed by turn_id when present; an event lacking one is still recorded under a synthetic key and never dropped.
Log rotation bounds total on-disk size; overflowing a small cap rotates/prunes oldest segments, and prior segments are never truncated.
After a restart, records written before the restart are still present and readable.
wm-lucid tap streams live events as one JSON object per line, honors --topic, and exits cleanly when its stdout pipe closes.
A wm-lucid.service systemd-user unit installs, enables, and comes up active with correct ordering deps.

fleet_note: lucid-explain, lucid-live, lucid-mind, lucid-trace, lucid-turn-id extend this same wintermute-lucid repo. The Record schema and on-disk log format above are the contract they build on; treat them as additive-only.
